title: Gambas al Ajillo with Chilli and Bread
summary: A classic Spanish prawn tapa made with sizzling garlic, olive oil and chilli, served with crusty bread for soaking up every last drop. It’s quick, fragrant and perfect for a relaxed dinner.
steps: Slice the garlic and chilli, and chop the parsley. Pat the prawns dry with kitchen paper so they sear well.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring often, until the garlic is fragrant and just starting to turn pale gold.
Stir in the paprika, then add the prawns, salt and black pepper. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until the prawns are pink, opaque and just cooked through.
Remove the pan from the heat and stir through the parsley. Taste and add a little more salt if needed.
Serve immediately with warm white bread for dipping into the garlicky oil.
